notes: Raw printed text only. Mapping to effects happens later (PLAN T2.1/T2.2).
number is the printed card number (n/10). The extracted file order is the reverse of the printed number (file 00 = card 5/10).
orientation: 'inverted' = printed upside down on the card (secrets, R-15.82, and some assets).
variants: a section without reputation subsections has a single variant with condition null. 'flavor' is the italic text; 'text' is the rules text.
errata: printed text is kept as is; the RULES.md errata entry is referenced and applied when mapping effects (RULES.md does not give the exact corrected wording).
Job skills: a skill printed in italics will certainly be tested (`certain: true`); the others may be tested (R-15.32).

variants.flavor: A Mon Calamari by the name of Raddus probes you about your loyalties.
variants.text: If you are not the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}7,000 to gain 1 fame. Otherwise, you may spend {CREDITS}15,000 to gain 1 fame.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation:
variants.flavor: A one-eyed Quarren leans close to you and whispers, “I heard you’re looking for a job.”
variants.text: Reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_JOB} market deck. You may buy 1 of these cards. Then shuffle the deck.

variants.flavor: Will you help root out traitors?
variants.text: Action: Choose another player who has {REP_POS} Rebel reputation or a Rebel crew. That player loses 1 Imperial reputation and you gain {CREDITS}2,000 and 1 Imperial reputation.

verify: Deck icon in the Mon Calamari text identified as {DECK_JOB} by comparing with the market deck backs.

variants.flavor: A cargo hauler offers to transport you and your ship across the galaxy.
variants.text: Action: Spend {CREDITS}3,000 to move directly to any space. If you have {REP_POS} Rebel reputation, you may do this for free.

variants.flavor: You have an opportunity to make a donation to the Academy for Young Imperials. Make it large enough, and they might even name a building after you.
variants.text: If you are not the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}7,000 to gain 1 fame. Otherwise, you may spend {CREDITS}15,000 to gain 1 fame.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation:
variants.flavor: The Academy for Young Imperials is looking for funds to bolster their flight training program.
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain 1 Imperial reputation.

variants.flavor: A Mon Calamari cruiser is embarking to meet up with a Rebel cell. You could probably hitch a ride.
variants.text: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation, you may move directly to the Rebel patrol’s space. If you do not move, you may gain 1 Rebel reputation. If you gain the reputation, lose 1 Imperial reputation.

variants.flavor: The Imperials are offering a good price for taking down Rebel agents.
variants.text: Encounter: Discard this card to fight a combat against a player in your space who has either {REP_POS} Rebel reputation or {REP_NEG} Imperial reputation. If you win, gain 1 fame and 1 Imperial reputation.

variants.flavor: The engineer offers to modify your hyperdrive with some military grade tech.
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to gain the mod below.

variants.flavor: Governor Pryce asks for help chasing down a Rebel ship.
variants.text: When you win a combat against a Rebel patrol, you may discard this card to gain 1 fame and 1 Imperial reputation.

asset.name: Hyperdrive Modification
text: You may discard this card during your planning step to gain +4 {HYPERDRIVE} until the end of the turn.

variants.flavor: “We’ve tracked a ship carrying Wookiee slaves to Kessel,” the Rebel operative tells you. “Are you up for a rescue mission?”
variants.text: You may gain the job below.

variants.flavor: “The Empire looks after its citizens,” the Imperial officer says as he assesses the damage.
variants.text: Recover all damage from your character and ship. If your character and ship did not have any damage, you instead gain {CREDITS}2,000.

asset.name: Wookiee Slave Trade
asset.reward: Gain {CREDITS}5,000, 1 fame, and 1 Rebel reputation. Then remove this card from the game.
